commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
BRANCHES='work/public-original-media work/fix-content-block-case-collision work/fix-mpo-photo-mime work/fix-rejected-original-retention work/final-storage-docs-audit'

echo '=== LOCAL MAIN + BRANCH CLEANUP ==='
git fetch origin --prune
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
git checkout main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
for b in $BRANCHES; do
  git rev-parse --verify "refs/remotes/origin/$b" >/dev/null
  git merge-base --is-ancestor "origin/$b" origin/main
  echo "merged_branch_verified=$b"
done
git push origin --delete $BRANCHES
git fetch origin --prune
for b in $BRANCHES; do
  if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$b"; then
    echo "remote branch still exists: $b"
    exit 60
  fi
  if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$b"; then
    git branch -D "$b"
  fi
done
REMOTE_BRANCHES=$(git ls-remote --heads origin | sed 's#.*refs/heads/##' | sort)
printf 'remote_branches_after_cleanup=\n%s\n' "$REMOTE_BRANCHES"
EXPECTED_BRANCHES=$(printf 'agent-control\nmain')
test "$REMOTE_BRANCHES" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCHES"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

echo '=== PRODUCTION DEPLOY + FINAL AUDIT ==='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
sudo -n true
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
OLD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo production_head_before=$OLD
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$OLD" "$EXPECTED"
if ! git diff --quiet "$OLD" "$EXPECTED" -- frontend; then
  echo 'unexpected frontend delta in final backend/docs deploy; refusing deploy without frontend build'
  git diff --name-only "$OLD" "$EXPECTED" -- frontend
  exit 61
fi
echo 'deploy_delta:'
git diff --name-only "$OLD" "$EXPECTED"

sudo -n systemctl stop photomap.service
restart_service() { sudo -n systemctl start photomap.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap restart_service EXIT
git checkout main
git merge --ff-only "$EXPECTED"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
( cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head )
make schema-check
PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
conn=sqlite3.connect('backend/data/app.db')
try:
    integrity=conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    version=conn.execute('SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version').fetchone()[0]
    assert integrity == 'ok', integrity
    assert version == '0021_nullable_rejected_original_path', version
    for table in ('photo','memory'):
        cols={row[1]: row for row in conn.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({table})')}
        assert cols['original_path'][3] == 0, (table, cols['original_path'])
    print('schema_integrity=ok alembic=' + version + ' original_path_nullable=photo,memory')
finally:
    conn.close()
PY

sudo -n systemctl start photomap.service
trap - EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/tmp/photomap-final-health.json; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
test "$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
echo -n 'health='
cat /tmp/photomap-final-health.json
echo

mkdir -p .dev
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/retain_private_originals.py --dry-run --approved-days 1000000 --rejected-days 0 --output-json .dev/final-retention-dryrun-dcd99f0.json
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.dev/final-retention-dryrun-dcd99f0.json').read_text())
a=r['summary']['actions']; i=r['summary']['issues']['by_severity']
assert i == {'error': 0, 'warning': 0, 'info': 0}, i
assert a['approved_replaced'] == 0, a
print('retention_dryrun=' + json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True))
print('retention_issues=' + json.dumps(i, sort_keys=True))
PY

backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/diagnose_local_data.py --output-json .dev/final-diagnostics-dcd99f0.json
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.dev/final-diagnostics-dcd99f0.json').read_text())
i=r['summary']['issues']['by_severity']; s=r['summary']['storage']
assert i == {'error': 0, 'warning': 0, 'info': 0}, i
assert s['orphan_private_files'] == 0, s
assert s['orphan_public_files'] == 0, s
print('diagnostics_status=' + r['status'])
print('diagnostics_issues=' + json.dumps(i, sort_keys=True))
print('diagnostics_storage=' + json.dumps(s, sort_keys=True))
PY

PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
conn=sqlite3.connect('backend/data/app.db')
try:
    integrity=conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    assert integrity == 'ok', integrity
    photo_total=conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo').fetchone()[0]
    approved=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE status='approved'").fetchone()[0]
    rejected=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE status='rejected'").fetchone()[0]
    rejected_nonnull=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE status='rejected' AND original_path IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]
    invalid_null=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE status!='rejected' AND original_path IS NULL").fetchone()[0]
    api_urls=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE status='approved' AND public_path LIKE '/api/places/%/photos/%/media/image'").fetchone()[0]
    legacy_urls=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo WHERE status='approved' AND public_path LIKE '/media/%'").fetchone()[0]
    memory_total=conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory').fetchone()[0]
    memory_rejected_nonnull=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory WHERE status='rejected' AND original_path IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]
    memory_invalid_null=conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory WHERE status!='rejected' AND original_path IS NULL").fetchone()[0]
    assert approved == 1188, approved
    assert api_urls == approved, (api_urls, approved)
    assert legacy_urls == 0, legacy_urls
    assert rejected_nonnull == 0, rejected_nonnull
    assert invalid_null == 0, invalid_null
    assert memory_rejected_nonnull == 0, memory_rejected_nonnull
    assert memory_invalid_null == 0, memory_invalid_null
    print(f'sqlite_integrity={integrity} photo_total={photo_total} approved={approved} rejected={rejected} rejected_original_nonnull={rejected_nonnull} api_urls={api_urls} legacy_urls={legacy_urls} memory_total={memory_total}')
finally:
    conn.close()
PY

PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY' > .dev/final-mpo-sample-dcd99f0.tsv
from PIL import Image
from sqlmodel import Session, create_engine, select
from app.core.config import DATABASE_URL
from app.models.city import City
from app.models.photo import Photo
from app.models.place import Place
from app.services.photo_media import private_photo_image_path, photo_image_media_type
engine=create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
with Session(engine) as s:
    photos=list(s.exec(select(Photo).join(Place, Photo.place_id == Place.id).join(City, Place.city_id == City.id).where(Photo.status == 'approved', Place.status == 'published', City.status == 'active').order_by(Photo.id)).all())
for p in photos:
    if p.original_path is None or not p.original_path.lower().endswith('.bin'):
        continue
    path=private_photo_image_path(p)
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        if im.format == 'MPO':
            mime=photo_image_media_type(path)
            assert mime == 'image/jpeg', mime
            print(f'{p.id}\t{path}\t{p.public_path}')
            break
else:
    raise SystemExit('no public MPO sample found')
PY
IFS=$'\t' read -r photo_id original url < .dev/final-mpo-sample-dcd99f0.tsv
tmp=.dev/final-mpo-http-dcd99f0.bin
hdr=.dev/final-mpo-http-dcd99f0.headers
curl -fsS --max-time 60 -D "$hdr" "http://127.0.0.1:8000$url" -o "$tmp"
orig_sha=$(sha256sum "$original" | awk '{print $1}')
http_sha=$(sha256sum "$tmp" | awk '{print $1}')
ctype=$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^content-type:/{gsub("\r",""); print $0}' "$hdr" | tail -n1)
test "$orig_sha" = "$http_sha"
printf '%s\n' "$ctype" | grep -qi '^content-type: image/jpeg'
echo "mpo_hash_check photo=$photo_id original=$orig_sha http=$http_sha $ctype"

printf 'root_http='
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/
echo service_status=$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)
echo production_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo storage_bytes=$(du -sb backend/storage | awk '{print $1}')
df -B1 / | tail -n1
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

echo '=== REMOVE KNOWN VALIDATED TEMP ARTIFACTS ==='
rm -f "$tmp" "$hdr" .dev/final-mpo-sample-dcd99f0.tsv
rm -f .dev/final-retention-dryrun-dcd99f0.json .dev/final-diagnostics-dcd99f0.json
rm -f .dev/app.db.pre-original-migration-ca165a9.sqlite
rm -f .dev/app.db.pre-rejected-retention-0021-3997b2a.sqlite
rm -f .dev/retain-rejected-dryrun-3997b2a.json .dev/retain-rejected-apply-3997b2a.json .dev/retain-rejected-postdryrun-3997b2a.json .dev/diagnose-after-rejected-retention-3997b2a.json .dev/diagnose-final-a47d2e8.json
for f in .dev/app.db.pre-original-migration-ca165a9.sqlite .dev/app.db.pre-rejected-retention-0021-3997b2a.sqlite .dev/retain-rejected-dryrun-3997b2a.json .dev/retain-rejected-apply-3997b2a.json .dev/retain-rejected-postdryrun-3997b2a.json .dev/diagnose-after-rejected-retention-3997b2a.json .dev/diagnose-final-a47d2e8.json; do
  test ! -e "$f"
done
echo temp_artifacts_cleanup=ok
echo final_production_audit=ok
REMOTE

printf 'public_root_http='
curl -L -sS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://photomap.pl/
test "$(curl -L -sS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://photomap.pl/)" = 200
echo local_main_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo final_cleanup_deploy_audit_verified
